words.ex: There is a big whiteboard in my classroom.
There are twenty desks in our classroom.
My chair is blue.
Is there a computer in your classroom?
There is a bookcase next to the door.
There are three windows in my classroom.

dialogue.t: Look at this picture. It's a classroom.
Wow! There is a big whiteboard.
Yes. How many desks are there?
There are twenty desks.
Is there a computer?
Yes, there is. It's on the teacher's desk.
Are there any windows?
Yes, there are. There are four windows.

grammar.title: There is / There are
grammar.ar: نستخدم There is بمعنى (يوجد) مع الاسم المفرد، مثل: There is a whiteboard. ونستخدم There are مع الاسم الجمع، مثل: There are twenty desks. وللسؤال نضع is أو are في البداية: Is there a computer? والجواب القصير: Yes, there is. أو No, there isn't.
examples: There is a clock on the wall.
There are five computers in the classroom.
Is there a bookcase? No, there isn't.

words.ex: The book is on the desk.
The pencil is in my bag.
The ball is under the chair.
My bed is next to the window.
The lamp is between the bed and the desk.
My shoes are behind the door.

dialogue.t: Let's play a game! Where is the cat?
Hmm... It's under the bed!
Yes, well done! Where are the books?
They're on the desk.
No, look again.
Oh! They're behind the door.
Great! Now you ask me.
Where is the lamp? It's between the bed and the chair.

grammar.title: Where is / Where are + prepositions
grammar.ar: نسأل عن مكان شيء مفرد بـ Where is the ...? ونجيب بـ It's ... ونسأل عن الجمع بـ Where are the ...? ونجيب بـ They're ... بعد ذلك نستخدم حرف جر يدل على المكان مثل on (على) وin (في) وunder (تحت) وnext to (بجانب) وbehind (خلف) وbetween (بين)، ثم كلمة the والاسم.
examples: Where is the ruler? It's in the box.
Where are my socks? They're under the bed.
The bag is between the desk and the chair.

words.ex: I like Maths because it's easy.
My favourite subject is Science.
I like Art because it's fun.
We have PE on Monday.
English is easy for me.
I don't like Maths because it's difficult.

dialogue.t: What's your favourite subject?
My favourite subject is Art.
Why do you like Art?
I like Art because it's fun. I love drawing!
Do you like Maths?
No, I don't like Maths because it's difficult. What about you?
I like Maths because it's easy for me.
Cool! Maybe you can help me.

grammar.title: I like / I don't like ... because ...
grammar.ar: نقول My favourite subject is ... للتعبير عن مادتنا المفضلة. ونستخدم I like للتعبير عن الحب، وI don't like للنفي. وكلمة because تعني (لأنّ) وتأتي بعدها السبب، مثل: because it's fun (لأنها ممتعة).
examples: My favourite subject is English.
I like Science because it's fun.
I don't like PE because it's difficult.

words.ex: There is a big mosque near my house.
I play football in the park.
My mother goes to the supermarket on Friday.
There is a hospital in my town.
There isn't a cinema near my house.
The park is near my school.

dialogue.t: Tell me about your neighbourhood.
There is a big mosque near my house.
Nice! Is there a park?
No, there isn't. But there is a supermarket.
Is there a cinema?
No, there isn't a cinema. Is there a park near your house?
Yes, there is. I play there every day.
Lucky you!

grammar.title: There is / There isn't in my town
grammar.ar: نستخدم There is للتعبير عن وجود مكان في الحي، ونستخدم There isn't (اختصار there is not) للتعبير عن عدم وجوده. للسؤال نقول Is there a ...? والجواب Yes, there is. أو No, there isn't. ونستخدم near بمعنى (قريب من).
examples: There is a hospital near my school.
There isn't a supermarket in my street.
Is there a park? No, there isn't.

words.ex: I go to school by bus.
We go to the supermarket by car.
I walk to the mosque with my brother.
My father drives me to school.
I ride a bike to the park.
My school is far from my house.

dialogue.t: How do you go to school?
I go to school by bus. My school is far.
I go by car. My father drives me.
How do you go to the park?
I walk. It's near my house.
I ride a bike to the park!
That's fun! Can we ride together?
Yes, let's go on Saturday!

grammar.title: How do you go? - by bus / I walk
grammar.ar: نسأل عن وسيلة التنقل بـ How do you go to ...? ونجيب بـ by + وسيلة النقل بدون the، مثل: by bus أو by car. لكن مع المشي نقول I walk ولا نقول by walk. ومع he وshe نضيف s للفعل، مثل: My father drives me.
examples: I go to the hospital by car.
How do you go to the mosque? I walk.
My mother drives me to the park.

words.ex: Go straight and you can see the park.
Turn left at the mosque.
Turn right at the supermarket.
The school is opposite the bank.
There is a bank next to the hospital.
Excuse me, where is the park?

dialogue.t: Excuse me, where is the library?
Go straight.
Go straight. OK.
Then turn left at the mosque.
Turn left at the mosque. And then?
It's opposite the bank.
Thank you very much!
You're welcome!

grammar.title: Giving directions
grammar.ar: عند إعطاء الاتجاهات نبدأ الجملة بالفعل مباشرة بدون فاعل، مثل: Go straight وTurn left وTurn right. وللسؤال عن مكان بأدب نقول Excuse me, where is the ...? ونستخدم opposite بمعنى (مقابل) لوصف موقع المكان.
examples: Turn right at the hospital.
Excuse me, where is the supermarket?
The park is opposite the school.

words.ex: This is my family photo.
I have got one brother.
My sister is ten years old.
This is my grandmother. She is kind.
My uncle has got a big car.
I am eight years old.

dialogue.t: Hello! Is this your family photo?
Yes, it is. This is my father.
He looks kind! And who is this girl?
This is my sister, Mariam. She is ten years old.
Have you got any brothers?
Yes. I have got two brothers and one sister.
Wow, a big family! Who is this baby?
This is my brother Omar. He is one year old.

grammar.title: This is my... / He is... / I have got...
grammar.ar: نستخدم "This is my" لنقدّم شخصًا من عائلتنا، مثل: This is my mother. نستخدم "He" للمذكر و"She" للمؤنث. للتعبير عن العمر نقول "He is 8 years old" ولا ننسى كلمة is. ونستخدم "I have got" بمعنى "لديّ"، ونضيف s للجمع: two brothers.
examples: This is my grandfather.
She is seven years old.
I have got two sisters and one brother.

words.ex: My father is very tall.
My sister has got short hair.
My mum has got long black hair.
My grandfather has got a grey beard.
My cousin has got curly hair.
My grandmother has got glasses.

dialogue.t: Can you guess who this is? He has got short white hair.
Is he tall?
Yes, he is very tall. He has got glasses too.
Is it your father?
No, it isn't! He has got a grey beard.
Oh! Is it your grandfather?
Yes, it is! Good guess!

grammar.title: has got + adjective + noun
grammar.ar: في الإنجليزية تأتي الصفة قبل الاسم، فنقول black hair (شعر أسود) وليس hair black. نستخدم "has got" مع He و She وأسماء الأشخاص لوصف الشعر واللحية والنظارة. ونستخدم "is" مع الصفات مثل tall و short.
examples: He has got short black hair.
She is tall.
My grandfather has got a grey beard.

words.ex: I wake up at six o'clock.
I wash my face with cold water.
I brush my teeth every morning.
Then I get dressed for school.
I have breakfast with my family.
I wake up. Then I wash my face.

dialogue.t: What do you do in the morning?
I wake up at six o'clock.
What do you do then?
Then I wash my face and brush my teeth.
And after that?
After that, I get dressed and I have breakfast with my family.
What do you eat?
I eat eggs and bread. Then I go to school.

grammar.title: My routine: First, Then, After that
grammar.ar: نستخدم المضارع البسيط للحديث عن الأشياء التي نفعلها كل يوم، مثل: I wake up. لا نضع am قبل الفعل، فلا نقول I am wake up. ونستخدم كلمات الترتيب First ثم Then ثم After that لنحكي خطوة بعد خطوة.
examples: First, I wake up at half past five.
Then I brush my teeth.
After that, I have breakfast with my family.

words.ex: I go to bed at eight o'clock.
School starts at half past seven.
Dhuhr prayer is at twelve o'clock.
We have lunch at two o'clock.
I go to bed at nine o'clock.
Look at the clock. It's seven o'clock!

dialogue.t: What time do you go to school?
At half past seven, I go to school.
What time do you pray Dhuhr?
I pray Dhuhr at twelve o'clock at school.
What time do you have lunch?
I have lunch at two o'clock with my family.
And what time do you go to bed?
I go to bed at eight o'clock. What about you?

grammar.title: What time do you...? / at + time
grammar.ar: نسأل عن الوقت بـ "What time do you...?" ثم نضع الفعل. في الجواب نستخدم at قبل الوقت، مثل: at six o'clock. نقول o'clock للساعة الكاملة فقط، ونقول half past للنصف، مثل: half past seven تعني السابعة والنصف.
examples: What time do you wake up?
I have lunch at one o'clock.
At half past seven, I go to school.

words.ex: I help my mum in the kitchen.
I make my bed every morning.
I clean my room on Saturday.
My dad washes the dishes after dinner.
My sister sets the table for lunch.
My grandfather waters the plants.

dialogue.t: Do you help at home?
Yes, I do. I help my mum in the kitchen.
Do you clean your room?
Yes, I do. And I make my bed every morning.
Great! What about your brother and sister?
My brother makes his bed. My sister sets the table.
Do you wash the dishes?
No, I don't. My dad washes the dishes!

grammar.title: Do you...? Yes, I do. / He makes...
grammar.ar: نسأل بـ "Do you...?" ونجيب إجابة قصيرة: Yes, I do أو No, I don't. عندما نتحدث عن He أو She أو شخص واحد مثل my brother، نضيف s أو es إلى الفعل: makes، washes. أما مع I و You فلا نضيف شيئًا.
examples: I help my mum.
My brother makes his bed.
Do you clean your room? No, I don't.

words.ex: I play with my cousins at the weekend.
On Friday, we go to the mosque.
I don't go to school on Saturday.
On Friday, I visit my grandmother.
We usually have dinner at seven o'clock.
I do my homework in the evening.

dialogue.t: What do you do on a school day?
I go to school, and I do my homework in the evening.
What about Friday?
On Friday, I visit my grandmother. We have a big lunch.
Do you go to school on Saturday?
No, I don't go to school on Saturday. I play football with my cousins.
That sounds fun! What do you do in the evening?
We usually watch TV together.

grammar.title: on + day / don't / usually
grammar.ar: نستخدم on قبل أيام الأسبوع، مثل: on Friday، ونستخدم in مع the evening. للنفي نضع don't قبل الفعل: I don't go to school. وتأتي كلمة usually (عادةً) قبل الفعل مباشرة: We usually play.
examples: On Friday, I visit my grandmother.
I don't go to school on Saturday.
We usually read stories in the evening.

words.ex: I like kabsa with chicken.
My grandma likes dates.
Do you like orange juice?
I don't like rice.
My favourite food is chicken.
My favourite drink is milk.

dialogue.t: Hi, Sara! Do you like kabsa?
Yes, I do. I like kabsa with chicken.
Me too! Do you like dates?
No, I don't. I don't like dates.
What's your favourite drink?
My favourite drink is mango juice. And you?
I like apple juice. My favourite food is pizza!

grammar.title: I like / I don't like / Do you like?
grammar.ar: نستخدم I like لنقول إننا نحب شيئًا، ونستخدم I don't like لنقول إننا لا نحبه. للسؤال نبدأ بـ Do you like...? ونجيب بـ Yes, I do أو No, I don't. عندما نتحدث عن نوع من الطعام بشكل عام نستخدم الجمع مثل dates و apples.
examples: I like juice.
I don't like carrots.
Do you like dates? Yes, I do.

words.ex: Can I have the menu, please?
The waiter brings the food.
I'd like some soup, please.
Would you like a salad?
Can I have a glass of water, please?
Would you like some dessert?

dialogue.t: Hello! Here's the menu. What would you like?
I'd like chicken and rice, please.
Would you like a salad?
Yes, please.
And to drink?
Can I have some water, please?
Of course. Would you like some dessert?
No, thank you.

grammar.title: Polite requests and offers
grammar.ar: عبارة I'd like هي اختصار I would like، وهي طريقة مهذبة للطلب بدل I want. نستخدم Can I have...? لنطلب شيئًا بأدب، ونضيف please في النهاية. أما Would you like...? فهي سؤال نعرض به شيئًا على شخص آخر، ونجيب بـ Yes, please أو No, thank you.
examples: I'd like some soup, please.
Can I have some juice, please?
Would you like some bread? No, thank you.

words.ex: My lunchbox is blue.
There is some bread in my lunchbox.
We need some cheese.
Are there any vegetables?
There aren't any sweets.
Fruit is healthy.

dialogue.t: Let's make a healthy lunchbox. Is there any fruit?
Yes, there is. There are some apples.
Good! Is there any bread?
Yes. There is some bread and some cheese.
Are there any sweets?
No, there aren't any sweets. Sweets aren't healthy.
That's right. We need some water too.
OK! Here's a bottle of water.

grammar.title: There is / There are with some and any
grammar.ar: نستخدم There is مع الشيء المفرد أو الذي لا يُعدّ مثل bread و water، ونستخدم There are مع الجمع مثل apples. نستخدم some في الجمل المثبتة، ونستخدم any في الجمل المنفية والأسئلة.
examples: There is some bread.
There aren't any sweets.
Is there any fruit?

words.ex: We go to the souq on Friday.
It's ten riyals.
How much is the ball?
How much are the mangoes?
I want a red toy car.
The bananas are cheap.

dialogue.t: Hello! Can I help you?
Yes, please. How much are the mangoes?
They're five riyals.
OK. And how much is the toy car?
It's ten riyals.
I'd like the mangoes and the toy car, please.
That's fifteen riyals, please.
Here you are. Thank you!

grammar.title: How much is / How much are?
grammar.ar: نستخدم How much is the...? لنسأل عن سعر شيء مفرد، ونجيب بـ It's.... ونستخدم How much are the...? لنسأل عن سعر أشياء بالجمع، ونجيب بـ They're.... بعد الأرقام الأكبر من واحد نقول riyals بالجمع.
examples: How much is the ball? It's two riyals.
How much are the bananas? They're five riyals.
How much is the doll? It's twenty riyals.

words.ex: We are happy at Eid.
We buy new clothes for Eid.
We visit our cousins.
I get presents at Eid.
My mother makes ma'amoul.
We visit our grandparents.

dialogue.t: What does your family do for Eid?
We buy new clothes. I have a new dress!
That's nice! What does your mother make?
My mother makes ma'amoul and a big cake.
Yummy! Do you visit your family?
Yes, we visit our cousins and our grandma.
Do you get presents?
Yes! I get presents and money from my uncle.

grammar.title: Present simple for things we do every year
grammar.ar: نستخدم المضارع البسيط للحديث عن أشياء نفعلها كل سنة أو بشكل متكرر. مع I و We و They يبقى الفعل كما هو، مثل We buy. أما مع He و She أو My mother فنضيف s إلى الفعل، مثل My mother makes.
examples: We buy new clothes.
My mother makes ma'amoul.
I get presents.

words.ex: Can you come to my party?
Here is your invitation.
My party is on Saturday.
It's at four o'clock.
We are going to have balloons.
We are going to play games.

dialogue.t: Teacher, can you come to my party?
Thank you! When is it?
It's on Saturday at four o'clock.
What are you going to have?
We are going to have a big cake, balloons and games.
That sounds fun! Yes, I can come.
Great! Here is your invitation.
Thank you. See you on Saturday!

grammar.title: Invitations and going to for plans
grammar.ar: نستخدم Can you come to...? لدعوة شخص، ونجيب بـ Yes, I can أو Sorry, I can't. للحديث عن خطط في المستقبل نستخدم We are going to + الفعل، مثل We are going to have a cake. نقول on مع الأيام مثل on Saturday، ونقول at مع الوقت مثل at four o'clock.
examples: Can you come to my party? Yes, I can.
It's on Friday at five o'clock.
We are going to have pizza and juice.

words.ex: I can swim in the sea.
My brother can ride a bike.
I can't ride a horse.
Can you climb a tree?
My sister can skate very well.
I can draw very well.

dialogue.t: Hi, Omar! Can you swim?
Yes, I can. I can swim very well.
Wow! Can you ride a horse?
No, I can't. Can you ride a horse?
Yes, I can. My dad has a horse.
Cool! I can ride a bike. Can you?
No, I can't. Can you help me?
Yes, of course!

grammar.title: Can and Can't for Abilities
grammar.ar: نستخدم can للتعبير عن شيء نستطيع فعله، و can't للتعبير عن شيء لا نستطيع فعله. يأتي بعدهما الفعل في صورته الأساسية بدون إضافة s أو to. للسؤال نضع Can في بداية الجملة، ونجيب بـ Yes, I can أو No, I can't.
examples: I can swim.
She can't ride a horse.
Can you climb a tree? Yes, I can.

words.ex: I like drawing animals.
I love playing football with my friends.
My mum likes reading books.
I don't like singing.
My brother loves playing video games.
My hobby is drawing.

dialogue.t: What do you like doing, Sara?
I like drawing. I draw cats and flowers.
Nice! I don't like drawing. I love reading.
Me too! I love reading stories.
Do you like playing football?
No, I don't like playing football. Do you?
Yes, I do! But we both love reading.
Let's read a book together!

grammar.title: Like / Love / Don't Like + -ing
grammar.ar: عندما نتحدث عن الهوايات نستخدم like (يحب) أو love (يحب كثيرًا) أو don't like (لا يحب)، ونضيف ing إلى الفعل الذي بعدها. مثلًا: draw تصبح drawing، و play تصبح playing. وللسؤال عن هوايات شخص نقول: What do you like doing?
examples: I like drawing.
I love playing football.
I don't like swimming.

words.ex: The boy is running in the park.
The girl is jumping.
He is kicking a ball.
She is throwing the ball.
The man is catching the ball.
They are flying a kite.

dialogue.t: Look at the picture. What is the boy doing?
He's running. He's very fast!
And what is she doing?
She's flying a kite. It's red.
What are they doing?
They are playing basketball.
Is the man throwing the ball?
No, he isn't. He's catching the ball.

grammar.title: Present Continuous: is / are + -ing
grammar.ar: نستخدم المضارع المستمر لوصف ما يحدث الآن أو ما نراه في الصورة. نستخدم is مع شخص واحد (he / she)، و are مع أكثر من شخص (they)، ثم نضيف ing إلى الفعل. للسؤال نقول: What is she doing? أو What are they doing?
examples: The boy is running.
They are playing basketball.
What is she doing? She's jumping.

words.ex: It's hot in Riyadh in summer.
It's sunny today.
It's windy in the desert today.
It's cold in Abha in winter.
It's rainy in Jeddah today.
When it's cold, I wear a jacket.

dialogue.t: What's the weather like in Riyadh today?
It's hot and sunny in Riyadh.
And in Jeddah?
It's windy today in Jeddah.
What about Abha?
It's cold and rainy in Abha.
What do you wear when it's cold?
When it's cold, I wear a jacket.

grammar.title: It's + Weather Words
grammar.ar: للحديث عن الطقس نستخدم It's (اختصار It is) ثم كلمة تصف الطقس مثل hot أو cold أو sunny. وللسؤال عن الطقس نقول: What's the weather like? ونستخدم When it's... لنقول ماذا نلبس في كل طقس.
examples: It's hot and sunny in Riyadh.
It's windy today.
When it's cold, I wear a jacket.

words.ex: We go to the desert with my family.
We go camping in winter.
We sleep in a big tent.
At night, we look at the stars.
We play on the beach in Jeddah.
We sit near the campfire.

dialogue.t: Do you go to the desert with your family?
Yes! We go camping in winter.
What do you do there?
We sit near the campfire. At night, we look at the stars.
Do you like it?
Yes! It's fun because I play with my cousins.
I like the beach. It's fun because I can swim.
That's great!

grammar.title: Present Simple for Routines + because
grammar.ar: نستخدم المضارع البسيط للحديث عن أشياء نفعلها عادة أو بشكل متكرر، مثل رحلات العائلة. مع we و I نستخدم الفعل بدون إضافة s. ونستخدم كلمة because (لأن) لنعطي سببًا.
examples: We go camping in winter.
At night, we look at the stars.
It's fun because we play games.

words.ex: Yesterday I was at school.
I was at home yesterday.
The weather was hot.
Were you happy yesterday?
It was great!
I was tired after football.

dialogue.t: Hello, Khalid. Where were you yesterday?
Yesterday I was at home with my family.
What was the weather like?
The weather was hot and sunny.
Were you happy?
Yes, I was. I played with my brother.
Was it fun?
Yes! It was great!

grammar.title: Was and Were (Past of Be)
grammar.ar: نستخدم was و were للحديث عن الماضي، مثل أمس. نستخدم was مع I و he و she و it، ونستخدم were مع you و we و they. للسؤال نضع Was أو Were في أول الجملة، ونجيب بـ Yes, I was أو No, I wasn't.
examples: Yesterday I was at school.
The weather was hot.
Were you happy? Yes, I was.

units.cando: Can describe family members and talk about simple daily routines using short connected sentences.
lessons: Meet My Family
Show a family photo and introduce family members to the teacher
This is my ___. / He/She is ___ years old. / I have got two brothers and one sister.
What Do They Look Like?
Describe a family member so the teacher can guess who it is
He has got short black hair. / She is tall. / My grandfather has got a grey beard.
My Morning
Tell the teacher what you do before school, step by step
I wake up at ___. / Then I ___. / After that, I have breakfast with my family.
What Time Is It?
Ask and answer about times for school, prayer, lunch and bed
What time do you ___? / I ___ at six o'clock. / At half past seven, I go to school.
Helping at Home
Talk about jobs you and your family do at home
I help my mum. / My brother makes his bed. / Do you clean your room? Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
My Evening and Weekend
Compare a school day with a Friday or Saturday
On Friday, I visit my grandmother. / I don't go to school on Saturday. / We usually ___ in the evening.

units.cando: Can describe places at school and in the neighbourhood and ask and answer simple questions about where things are.
lessons: My Classroom
Describe your classroom and find objects in a picture with the teacher
There is a whiteboard. / There are twenty desks. / Is there a computer? Yes, there is.
Where Is It?
Play a find-the-object game using a classroom or bedroom picture
Where is the ___? / It's on/in/under/next to/between the ___. / They're behind the door.
Favourite Subjects
Talk about school subjects and say why you like them
My favourite subject is ___. / I like ___ because it's fun/easy. / I don't like ___ because it's difficult.
Places in My Town
Describe your neighbourhood: mosque, park, supermarket, hospital
There is a big mosque near my house. / There isn't a cinema. / Is there a park? No, there isn't.
How Do You Go There?
Explain how you travel to school and other places
I go to school by bus/car. / My father drives me. / How do you go to the park? I walk.
Find the Way
Give and follow simple directions on a map to reach a place
Go straight. / Turn left/right. / It's opposite the bank. / Excuse me, where is the ___?

units.cando: Can talk about food preferences, order and buy simple items, and describe family celebrations using familiar phrases.
lessons: Food I Like
Talk about favourite foods and drinks, like kabsa, dates and juice
I like ___. / I don't like ___. / Do you like ___? Yes, I do. / My favourite food is ___.
At the Restaurant
Role-play ordering a meal at a family restaurant
I'd like ___, please. / Can I have some water, please? / Would you like ___? Yes, please. / No, thank you.
Healthy Lunchbox
Plan a healthy school lunch together with the teacher
There is some bread. / There aren't any sweets. / Is there any fruit? / We need some ___.
At the Market
Role-play buying fruit and toys at a souq or shop
How much is the ___? / It's ten riyals. / How much are the ___? / They're five riyals.
Getting Ready for Eid
Describe what your family does to prepare for Eid
We buy new clothes. / My mother makes ___. / We visit our cousins. / I get presents.
A Birthday Party
Plan a party and invite the teacher
Can you come to my party? / It's on ___ at ___. / We are going to have ___. / Yes, I can. / Sorry, I can't.

units.cando: Can talk about abilities, hobbies, the weather and what people are doing now, and say simply what happened yesterday.
lessons: What Can You Do?
Ask and answer about abilities and skills
I can swim. / I can't ride a horse. / Can you ___? Yes, I can. / No, I can't. / I can ___ very well.
My Hobbies
Share hobbies and find something you both enjoy
I like drawing. / I love playing football. / I don't like ___ing. / What do you like doing?
What Are They Doing?
Describe actions in a park or sports picture
The boy is running. / They are playing basketball. / What is she doing? She's ___ing.
Today's Weather
Describe the weather in Saudi cities and say what to wear
It's hot and sunny in Riyadh. / It's windy today. / When it's cold, I wear a jacket.
Desert Trip
Talk about a family trip to the desert or the beach
We go camping in winter. / At night, we look at the stars. / It's fun because ___.
Yesterday
Tell the teacher about yesterday and where you were
Yesterday I was at home/school. / The weather was hot. / Were you happy? Yes, I was. / It was great!
